statement: Whenever word_break(s, wordDict) returns Ok r, r = true if and only if there exist an integer k >= 1 and indices i_1, ..., i_k with 0 <= i_j < len(wordDict) such that s is the concatenation of the byte arrays wordDict[i_1], ..., wordDict[i_k] (indices may be repeated). Equivalently, there exist cut positions 0 = p_0 < p_1 < ... < p_k = len(s) such that for every j in [1,k], the block of bytes s[p_{j-1}], ..., s[p_j - 1] equals wordDict[i_j] for some i_j in [0,len(wordDict)).
preconditions: The input satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(s) <= 300; 1 <= len(wordDict) <= 1000; every wordDict[i] has length between 1 and 20 and consists only of lowercase ASCII bytes 'a'..'z'; s consists only of lowercase ASCII bytes 'a'..'z'; and all words wordDict[0], ..., wordDict[len(wordDict)-1] are pairwise distinct.
